title: Rewrite edit_block_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/carnivalBlock/editBlock/widgets/edit_block_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: FORM (prefilled).

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** EditBlockCubit(carnivalBlocksRepository, carnivalBlockId) is already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**Widgets to use:** Same as subtask_03 (create_block_screen) but with AppAppBar(title: 'Editar bloco') and prefilled AppTextField using initialValue from the existing block.

**Layout guidance:**
1. AppAppBar with title 'Editar bloco', showBackButton: true.
2. Body: SingleChildScrollView > AppCard with the form.
3. AppTextField for the block name with initial value loaded from cubit state (block.name). When state is loading initially, show AppLoading. When loaded, populate the controller.
4. AppButton at bottom - label 'Salvar alterações' (or 'Editar'), isLoading when state.status == loading; isDisabled when name is empty OR unchanged.
5. On submit success: AppSnackbar.success('Bloco atualizado'), then call cubit.loadBlock() to refresh + context.pop().
6. On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message.

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature, cubit API, all pt-BR strings, the prefilled initial value pattern (controller.text = state.block.name).
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Cubit constructor signature unchanged - EditBlockCubit(carnivalBlocksRepository, carnivalBlockId)
Screen widget class name `EditBlockScreen` and constructor `const EditBlockScreen({super.key})` preserved
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
AppTextField is prefilled with the existing block.name from cubit state
On submit success: AppSnackbar.success + cubit.loadBlock() (refresh) + context.pop()
On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message
